description: Get timezone info by IANA ID, country code, or partial city/region name. Returns current UTC offset, standard offset, whether DST is currently active, and major cities in the timezone. When querying by country code (ISO alpha-2), returns all timezones observed in that country. Accepts partial matches — "Tokyo" resolves to "Asia/Tokyo", "NY" resolves to "America/New_York".

at.description: ISO 8601 datetime to evaluate timezone state at a specific moment (e.g., "2026-01-15T12:00:00"). Defaults to current time.

by.description: Lookup mode: iana for exact IANA ID, country for ISO alpha-2 code, auto tries all strategies.

query.description: IANA timezone ID (e.g., "America/New_York"), ISO alpha-2 country code (e.g., "US"), or partial city/region name (e.g., "Tokyo", "London").

name: ref_timezone_lookup

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_match`: No timezone matched the query. `invalid_at`: The at parameter is not a valid ISO 8601 datetime string. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

evaluated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime at which timezone state was evaluated.

timezones.description: Matching timezone records. Multiple records when querying by country.

items.description: Timezone record with offset and DST info.

countries.description: ISO alpha-2 country codes observing this timezone.

current_offset_hours.description: Current UTC offset in hours (e.g., -5.0 for UTC-05:00).

dst_abbreviation.description: DST timezone abbreviation (e.g., "EDT"), or null when DST not active or timezone has no DST.

dst_active.description: Whether daylight saving time is currently active.

title: Timezone Lookup
